_comment: BAND-SPLIT-2. `clearings` and `footprints` cut from data/config/vegetation.json, merged back by scripts/data/band_content.gd. `order` equals the index each entry held in the pre-split file, so the merge reproduces it exactly -- see tests/test_band_vegetation.gd.

clearings._why: the village square and its structures
the practice meadow: the opening's bramblebun and the arena around it

R8.1: the practice trainer's ground north of the square (data/config/trainers.json). Same reason as the entries above -- a trainer battle's arena is 11m across and forms between the player and the creature their opponent just sent out, so without this the fight is watched through a tree. Most of it already falls inside the village square's own 22m clearing; this covers the northern edge that does not.

clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (clearings[5]). NOT explicitly named in the macro-layout doc's table (which lists `vegetation.footprints[2,3]` for the mill group but not this clearing), moved anyway to avoid leaving a stale tree-free clearing at the old (-133.5,110) once the mill/footbridge move to (-383.5,517).
clearings._why: EV6-remainder: the mill and its crossing -- keeps trees/rocks off the pad and the bridge approaches

clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (clearings[6]), same reasoning as clearings[5] above: not named explicitly in the table but moved to track the ranger station.
clearings._why: EV6-remainder: the ranger station and its yard on the pond route
SC14: the South Bridge and both its abutment aprons -- a tree or a boulder on either rim would stand between the player and the one thing the whole south road exists to show them
clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D: translated with south_bridge crossings[0] by the same (-5,+1250).
clearings._comment_ow5c_seam: OW5C follow-up: shifted +8 in x with south_bridge crossings[0] (WALL1 seam workaround).

clearings._why: BAND1-D1: the trail_camp prop cluster (props.json order 1000) and the ground its fire ring, seats and gear pile stand on. Moved from (348,919.5) r=12 with the cluster itself: the old site dropped 1.2m across the camp's own footprint (tools/_probe_camp_ground.gd) and (344,935) is the flattest shelf within 14m of the loop trail (tools/_probe_camp_flat.gd, 0.29m of relief over 8m). Radius tightened 12 -> 9 at the same time: the camp's outermost prop is 5.7m from centre, so 9 keeps a ~3m margin while letting scattered grass close back in near enough that the camp reads as a cleared spot rather than a bald patch in a field. NOTE for the coordinator: scatter_bake.gd::config_fingerprint() does not hash band vegetation files (GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT section 4), so this move does NOT invalidate the baked scatter on this branch and needs the single integration re-bake.

BAND1-D1 / PW2: the elder mosshell's hollow (spawns.json order 1900) and the arena a fight with it forms in. Same reasoning as clearings 3 and 4 above -- a trainer or wild battle arena is ~11m across and forms between the player and the creature, so without this the encounter is watched through a tree. NOTE for the coordinator: like the trail_camp move, this does NOT invalidate the baked scatter on this branch, because scatter_bake.gd::config_fingerprint() does not hash band vegetation files (GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT section 4). It needs the single integration re-bake.

BAND1-D1 / prompt 30: Old Bram's ground (trainers.json order 1010) and the arena his fight forms in. Same reasoning as clearings 3, 4 and 1900 -- a trainer battle arena is ~11m across and forms between the player and the creature their opponent just sent out, so without this the region's hardest optional fight is watched through a tree. NOTE for the coordinator: does NOT invalidate the baked scatter on this branch (GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT section 4); needs the single integration re-bake.

_comment_layer_anchors_vp4: VP4-CORRIDOR (docs/VISUAL_PARITY_STAGED_GOAL_PROMPT_V2.md). Merged onto the matching head-layer's own `anchors` by `scripts/world/scatter_rules.gd::_merge_band_layer_anchors` (added by this same pass -- see that function's own header). Each fixes a specific station in `tools/_capture_corridor.gd`'s before set where the walked route showed `player -> empty grass -> sky` with no mid-ground structure: see `ralph/reports/visual-parity/CORRIDOR/REPORT.md` for the before/after frames. Never on the path, never inside an existing clearing/footprint (checked against this file's own list above before siting each one).

trees._why: VP4 station 01-village-edge (14,20)->(8,90): the before frame's right-hand gap between the practice-field fence and the far tree line was bare grass all the way to the sky. A copse on the opposite side of the path from the fence, between the player and the horizon line, so the sightline gets a mid-ground read on both sides instead of only the fence side.

VP4 station 02-first-bend (-120,270)->(-230,330): the before frame was open grass with nothing between the player and a thin, distant tree line -- the worst 'empty grass to sky' case in band 1. A tree line flanking the outside of the path's own bend, opposite the rock cluster below, gives the bend a compression -> reveal read instead of a flat field.

ROUND 2 (JUDGE-round1.md), COORDINATES CORRECTED TWICE after this round's own renders: round 1's own additions at this station were confirmed present by crop diff but the round-1 judge found the station NET EMPTIER after the bake than before -- appending new anchors shifts every later draw's RNG position for the same layer corridor-wide, and here it looks to have thinned out whatever corridor-fill trees the before bake happened to land on this station's own screen-left. FIRST attempt ((-158,280)) rendered on screen-right, not left -- wrong side of the camera's true right axis `(-Fz,Fx)` = (-0.479,-0.878). SECOND attempt ((-126,302)) fixed the side (confirmed left, dot -25.0) but rendered invisible anyway: at 32.6m out it sat 50.8 degrees off the view axis, against a measured ~51.3-degree horizontal half-FOV at this aspect ratio -- literally the last half-degree of the frame, clipped/unreadable. This THIRD centre is built from angle, not just side: 35m out at 30 degrees off-axis (`eye + 35*(cos(30)*forward_unit + sin(30)*left_unit)`), comfortably inside the FOV rather than grazing its edge. Confirmed by render: a visible tree line now stands on screen-left. 8 trees (7-9 asked), radius 11 (trimmed from 13 so the cluster doesn't itself push instances back out past 40-45 degrees), two leaf variants only (CommonTree_1/_3, skipping _2) per the brief, >25m off the path centreline (past the 6m minimum).

ROUND 2, station 04-eastward-swing (360,910)->(430,1020), COORDINATES CORRECTED: JUDGE-round1.md called round 1's fix here 'the one real, working fix' but named the LEFT flank 'thin'. This round's first attempt ((412,1067)) used the same inverted left/right axis as station 02's grove above and rendered on the already-strong right side instead -- checked directly, its offset from the eye has a POSITIVE dot with the camera's true right axis here ((-0.843,0.537), from the same `(-Fz,Fx)` derivation), i.e. right, not left. This corrected centre has a NEGATIVE dot (-40.0, confirmed left) with that axis, ~165m out (within the 120-200m ask), balancing the already-good right flank without adding anything near the camera or path.

rocks._why: VP4 station 02-first-bend: a rock cluster at the bend itself (bible sec4C names this combination explicitly), mixed sizes via the layer's own 0.28-2.1 scale span. `min_slope_deg` overridden to 0 -- the layer's own floor of 6 degrees would reject most draws on this gentle meadow bend, the same override `_place_anchor`'s own doc names for a hillside outcrop, used here for the opposite reason (too flat, not too steep). ROUND 2 verified: this centre's own dot with the camera's true right axis is POSITIVE (+31.9, i.e. genuinely on the outside/right of the bend, matching the brief's round-2 ask) -- unlike the two anchors above, this one was already correctly sided and needed no change.

bushes._why: VP4 station 01: 2-4 bushes on the new tree copse's own edge, per the brief's own recipe.
VP4 station 02: edge planting beside the bend's rock cluster.

ROUND 2: 5 bushes on the round-2 grove's own PATH-FACING edge (the side toward station (-120,270)), per the brief. Coordinates corrected to the angle-based grove centre above (15m out at the same 30-degree bearing, i.e. between the eye and the grove core).

saplings._why: ROUND 2: 3 saplings on the same path-facing edge as the bushes above, completing the brief's 'bushes and saplings on its path-facing edge'. Coordinates corrected to the angle-based grove centre above (24m out at the same 30-degree bearing).

footprints._why: Grandpa's house, 9x7m inside plus walls -- grass was standing on the floor and the rug

the windmill -- at distance sqrt(18^2+14^2)=22.8m from the village-square clearing's own centre, just outside its 22m radius, so the rocks layer (which DOES respect clearings, unlike grass) could still land a boulder against its base. R9.4-remainder-8's survey found one doing exactly that, obscuring village.json's own stated landmark from the meadow view.

footprints._why: the mill -- grass out of the tower and from under the wheel

footprints._why: the footbridge -- grass off the deck and both stone landings

footprints._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (footprints[4]): (-100,100) -> (-350,507), same offset as the ranger station.

footprints._why: SC14: the South Bridge's deck and both stone landings -- the same treatment the mill's footbridge already gets, at this span's own half-length

R7.9: the inn, 6x10m plus walls (half-diagonal 5.83m) -- same footprint class as Grandpa's house above and given the same margin. Found the same way Grandpa's own entry was: a tools/capture_inn.gd render showed grass standing on the common room's floor and rug. Site moved once already (village.json's own `_why` on the `inn` structure records why); this entry has to move with it or it excludes nothing the inn actually stands on. T1-VILLAGE 2026-08-30: widened 6.5 -> 7.8. This pass's own door-canopy addition (building_prefabs.json `inn`, Overhang_Roof_Plaster + Roof_FrontSupports at the front gable) pushed the recipe's own combined AABB out to a 7.76m half-diagonal (probed: local X half 4.12, Z -5.90..6.58), past the old 5.83m-derived radius -- a tree or rock scattered under a canopy that did not exist when this entry was written.
